title: Rama consoles angry Lakshmana
introduction: This chapter describes Lakshmana's anger and Rama consoling Lakshmana.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकविंशः सर्गः ||
Thus this is the twenty first chapter in Ayodhya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana the first epic of Inida.

verses.devanagari:
तथा तु विलपन्तीम् ताम् कौसल्याम् राम मातरम् |
उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनः तत् काल सदृशम् वचः
verses.iast:
tathā tu vilapantīm tām kausalyām rāma mātaram |
uvāca lakṣmaṇo dīnaḥ tat kāla sadṛśam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Lakshmana became dejected and spoke these words, properly befitting for that time, to that Rama's mother Kausalya who was thus weeping.

verses.devanagari:
न रोचते मम अपि एतत् आर्ये यद् राघवो वनम् |
त्यक्त्वा राज्य श्रियम् गच्चेत् स्त्रिया वाक्य वशम् गतः
verses.iast:
na rocate mama api etat ārye yad rāghavo vanam |
tyaktvā rājya śriyam gaccet striyā vākya vaśam gataḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, the honoured lady ! I also do not like Rama to be influenced by the words of a woman and go to the forest, leaving the prosperous kingdom."

verses.devanagari:
विपरीतः च वृद्धः च विषयैः च प्रधर्षितः |
नृपः किम् इव न ब्रूयाच् चोद्यमानः समन्मथः
verses.iast:
viparītaḥ ca vṛddhaḥ ca viṣayaiḥ ca pradharṣitaḥ |
nṛpaḥ kim iva na brūyāc codyamānaḥ samanmathaḥ
verses.translation: "The king with perverted mind, of old age, one who is outraged by sensual enjoyments and possessed of passion can talk any thing, prompted by Kaikeyi."

verses.devanagari:
न अस्य अपराधम् पश्यामि न अपि दोषम् तथा विधम् |
येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्रात् वन वासाय राघवः
verses.iast:
na asya aparādham paśyāmi na api doṣam tathā vidham |
yena nirvāsyate rāṣṭrāt vana vāsāya rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "I can not see any offence or cause for blame in Rama that can expel him from the state to the forest."

verses.devanagari:
न तम् पश्याम्य् अहम् लोके परोक्षम् अपि यो नरः |
स्वमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्यदोषमुदाहरेत्
verses.iast:
na tam paśyāmy aham loke parokṣam api yo naraḥ |
svamitro'pi nirasto'pi yo'syadośhamudāharet
verses.translation: I have not seen in this world any person, whether an enemy or an expellee, speaking ill of Rama indirectly."

verses.devanagari:
देव कल्पम् ऋजुम् दान्तम् रिपूणाम् अपि वत्सलम् |
अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मम् त्यजेत् पुत्रम् अकारणात्
verses.iast:
deva kalpam ṛjum dāntam ripūṇām api vatsalam |
avekṣamāṇaḥ ko dharmam tyajet putram akāraṇāt
verses.translation: "Can anybody observing ethicalness, causelessly get rid of a son who is equal to god who is honest, who is self-restrained and who is affectionate even towards adversaries?"

verses.devanagari:
तत् इदम् वचनम् राज्ञः पुनर् बाल्यम् उपेयुषः |
पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्यात् राज व्ऱ्त्तम् अनुस्मरन्
verses.iast:
tat idam vacanam rāGYaḥ punar bālyam upeyuṣaḥ |
putraḥ ko hṛdaye kuryāt rāja vRttam anusmaran
verses.translation: "Which son, knowing royal usage, can agree to the words of this king who is behaving as though he got childhood again?"

verses.devanagari:
यावद् एव न जानाति कश्चित् अर्थम् इमम् नरः |
तावद् एव मया साधम् आत्मस्थम् कुरु शासनम्
verses.iast:
yāvad eva na jānāti kaścit artham imam naraḥ |
tāvad eva mayā sādham ātmastham kuru śāsanam
verses.translation: "Even before others get to know about this matter, make this dominion your own, with my help."

verses.devanagari:
मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव |
कः समर्थो अधिकम् कर्तुम् कृत अन्तस्य इव तिष्ठतः
verses.iast:
mayā pārśve sadhanuṣā tava guptasya rāghava |
kaḥ samartho adhikam kartum kṛta antasya iva tiṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! While I am standing by your side along with a bow, protecting you who are standing as God of Death, who is capable of doing too much ?"

verses.devanagari:
निर्मनुष्याम् इमाम् सर्वाम् अयोध्याम् मनुज ऋषभ |
करिष्यामि शरैअः तीक्ष्णैः यदि स्थास्यति विप्रिये
verses.iast:
nirmanuṣyām imām sarvām ayodhyām manuja ṛṣabha |
kariṣyāmi śaraiaḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ yadi sthāsyati vipriye
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best of men! If the city of Ayodhya turns against you, I shall make it desolate of men with sharp arrows"

glosses.meaning: Oh the best of men! sthaasyati yadi = If it stands

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य अथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वा अस्य हितम् इच्चति |
सर्वान् एतान् वधिष्यामि मृदुर् हि परिभूयते
verses.iast:
bharatasya atha pakṣyo vā yo vā asya hitam iccati |
sarvān etān vadhiṣyāmi mṛdur hi paribhūyate
verses.translation: "I shall kill all those who are siding Bharata ,and are favourable to him. Soft person indeed gets disgraced!"

verses.devanagari:
प्रोत्साहितोऽयम् कैकेय्या स दुष्टो यदिः पिता |
अमित्रभूतो निस्सङ्गम् वध्यताम् बध्यतामपि
verses.iast:
protsāhito'yam kaikeyyā sa duśhṭo yadiḥ pitā |
amitrabhūto nissaṇ^gam vadhyatām badhyatāmapi
verses.translation: "If our father with an evil mind behaves like our enemy with instigation by Kaikeyi. I shall keep him imprisoned with out personal attachment or if necessary, kill him."

verses.devanagari:
गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः |
उत्फथम् प्रतिपन्नस्य कार्यम् भवति शासन्म्
verses.iast:
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ |
utphatham pratipannasya kāryam bhavati śāsanm
verses.translation: "Even a venerable person is to be punished, if he becomes arrogant, if he does not know good and evil actions and if he takes to a wrong route."

verses.devanagari:
बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुम् वा पुरुषर्षभ |
दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्य राज्यम् स्थितमिदम् तव
verses.iast:
balameśha kimāśritya hetum vā puruśharśhabha |
dātumicchati kaikeyya rājyam sthitamidam tava
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best of men! On what strength or season has he taken shelter to give away this kingdom belonging to you to Kaikeyi?"

glosses.meaning: Oh the best of men! kim = what

verses.devanagari:
त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरम् अनुत्तमम् |
कस्य शक्तिः श्रियम् दातुम् भरताय अरि शासन
verses.iast:
tvayā caiva mayā caiva kṛtvā vairam anuttamam |
kasya śaktiḥ śriyam dātum bharatāya ari śāsana
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama the chestiser of enemies! Where is the ability for him to give kingdom to Bharata, by making great enmity against you and me "

glosses.itrans: the chastiser of enemies ! kaa shaktiH
glosses.iast: the castiser of enemies ! kā śaktiḥ
glosses.devanagari: थे चस्तिसेर् ओf एनेमिएस् ! का शक्तिः

verses.devanagari:
अनुरक्तः अस्मि भावेन भ्रातरम् देवि तत्त्वतः |
सत्येन धनुषा चैव दत्तेन इष्टेन ते शपे
verses.iast:
anuraktaḥ asmi bhāvena bhrātaram devi tattvataḥ |
satyena dhanuṣā caiva dattena iṣṭena te śape
verses.translation: "Oh, queen! Really, I am devotedly attached to my brother Rama. I am swearing an oath to you by truth by bow, by the act of giving and by the act of sacrifice."

verses.devanagari:
दीप्तम् अग्निम् अरण्यम् वा यदि रामः प्रवेक्ष्यते |
प्रविष्टम् तत्र माम् देवि त्वम् पूर्वम् अवधारय
verses.iast:
dīptam agnim araṇyam vā yadi rāmaḥ pravekṣyate |
praviṣṭam tatra mām devi tvam pūrvam avadhāraya
verses.translation: "Oh, queen! If Rama can enter blazing fire or forest, you make certain that even before, I can enter there"

verses.devanagari:
हरामि वीर्यात् दुह्खम् ते तमः सूर्यैव उदितः |
देवी पश्यतु मे वीर्यम् राघवः चैव पश्यतु
verses.iast:
harāmi vīryāt duhkham te tamaḥ sūryaiva uditaḥ |
devī paśyatu me vīryam rāghavaḥ caiva paśyatu
verses.translation: "I shall alleviate your grief, by showing my valour like the rising sun alleviating darkness .Let Rama and yourself see my valour"

verses.devanagari:
एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः |
उवाच रामम् कौसल्या रुदन्ती शोक लालसा
verses.iast:
etat tu vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
uvāca rāmam kausalyā rudantī śoka lālasā
verses.translation: Hearing these words of Lakshmana the magnanimous, Kausalya entirely given up to anguish and weaping, spoke thus to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातुस् ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतम् त्वया |
यद् अत्र अनन्तरम् तत् त्वम् कुरुष्व यदि रोचते
verses.iast:
bhrātus te vadataḥ putra lakṣmaṇasya śrutam tvayā |
yad atra anantaram tat tvam kuruṣva yadi rocate
verses.translation: "Oh, son !You have heard the words of Lakshmana .If you agree, you do what is to be done, immediately."

glosses.meaning: It is heard tvayaa = by you

verses.devanagari:
न च अधर्म्यम् वचः श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम् |
विहाय शोक सम्तप्ताम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि माम् इतः
verses.iast:
na ca adharmyam vacaḥ śrutvā sapatnyā mama bhāṣitam |
vihāya śoka samtaptām gantum arhasi mām itaḥ
verses.translation: "It is not proper for you to go away from here, leaving me afflicted with grief, after hearing the un-just words spoken by my co-wife."

verses.devanagari:
धर्मज्ञ यदि धर्मिष्ठो धर्मम् चरितुम् इच्चसि |
शुश्रूष माम् इहस्थः त्वम् चर धर्मम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
dharmaGYa yadi dharmiṣṭho dharmam caritum iccasi |
śuśrūṣa mām ihasthaḥ tvam cara dharmam anuttamam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! You are righteous man. If you desire to practice virtue, be a virtuous man and stay here serving me thereby practicing the best morality in the form of serving your mother.

glosses.itrans: the knower of goodness! tvam ichchhasi yadi
glosses.iast: the knover of goodness! tvam icchasi yadi
glosses.devanagari: थे क्नोवेर् ओf गोओद्नेस्स्! त्वं इच्च्हसि यदि

glosses.meaning: serve maam = me chara = practice anuttamam = best dharmam = goodness"

verses.devanagari:
शुश्रूषुर् जननीम् पुत्र स्व गृहे नियतः वसन् |
परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपः त्रिदिवम् गतः
verses.iast:
śuśrūṣur jananīm putra sva gṛhe niyataḥ vasan |
pareṇa tapasā yuktaḥ kāśyapaḥ tridivam gataḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, son! Formerly Kasyapa was staying in his own house itself with self restraint, performed great austerity by serving his mother and went to heaven"

verses.devanagari:
यथा एव राजा पूज्यः ते गौरवेण तथा हि अहम् |
त्वाम् न अहम् अनुजानामि न गन्तव्यम् इतः वनम्
verses.iast:
yathā eva rājā pūjyaḥ te gauraveṇa tathā hi aham |
tvām na aham anujānāmi na gantavyam itaḥ vanam
verses.translation: "Just as the king, by respectable feeling to you is worthy of worship, so also being your mother, I am worthy of worship to you. Hence, do not go to the forest"

verses.devanagari:
त्वद् वियोगान् न मे कार्यम् जीवितेन सुखेन वा |
त्वया सह मम श्रेयः तृणानाम् अपि भक्षणम्
verses.iast:
tvad viyogān na me kāryam jīvitena sukhena vā |
tvayā saha mama śreyaḥ tṛṇānām api bhakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "After your separation, I shall have no use of this life or comforts for me, it is good even to eat grass while staying with you"

verses.devanagari:
यदि त्वम् यास्यसि वनम् त्यक्त्वा माम् शोक लालसाम् |
अहम् प्रायम् इह आसिष्ये न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्
verses.iast:
yadi tvam yāsyasi vanam tyaktvā mām śoka lālasām |
aham prāyam iha āsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum
verses.translation: "I shall not live if you leave for the forest, leaving me who is afflicted with grief. I shall seek death through starvation"

glosses.meaning: I praayam asishhye = shall seek death through starvation

verses.devanagari:
ततः स्त्वम् प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयम् लोक विश्रुतम् |
ब्रह्म हत्याम् इव अधर्मात् समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः
verses.iast:
tataḥ stvam prāpsyase putra nirayam loka viśrutam |
brahma hatyām iva adharmāt samudraḥ saritām patiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, son! If I fast myself to death for your sake, you will attain the universally famous hell, like the god of the ocean obtaining trouble because of his un justice behaviour, towards the sage called Pippalada, producing the latter's wrath."

glosses.meaning: like obtaining the sin of killing a Brahmana by
lord of rivers adharmaat = due to un justice behaviour"

verses.devanagari:
विलपन्तीम् तथा दीनाम् कौसल्याम् जननीम् ततः |
उवाच रामः धर्म अत्मा वचनम् धर्म सम्हितम्
verses.iast:
vilapantīm tathā dīnām kausalyām jananīm tataḥ |
uvāca rāmaḥ dharma atmā vacanam dharma samhitam
verses.translation: The honest Rama spoke these virtuous words to his mother Kausalya, who was thus weeping miserably.

verses.devanagari:
न अस्ति शक्तिः पितुर् वाक्यम् समतिक्रमितुम् मम |
प्रसादये त्वाम् शिरसा गन्तुम् इच्चाम्य् अहम् वनम्
verses.iast:
na asti śaktiḥ pitur vākyam samatikramitum mama |
prasādaye tvām śirasā gantum iccāmy aham vanam
verses.translation: "I am not able to violate my father's words. I am bowing my head and asking your favour. I shall have to go to the forest"

verses.devanagari:
ऋषिणा च पितुर् वाक्यम् कुर्वता व्रत चारिणा |
गौर् हता जानता धर्मम् कण्डुना अपि विपश्चिता
verses.iast:
ṛṣiṇā ca pitur vākyam kurvatā vrata cāriṇā |
gaur hatā jānatā dharmam kaṇḍunā api vipaścitā
verses.translation: "A sage called Kandu, who knew righteousness, who performed religious vows and who was a learned man, killed even a cow, acting as per his father's words"

verses.devanagari:
अस्माकम् च कुले पूर्वम् सगरस्य आज्ञया पितुः |
खनद्भिः सागरैः भूतिम् अवाप्तः सुमहान् वधः
verses.iast:
asmākam ca kule pūrvam sagarasya āGYayā pituḥ |
khanadbhiḥ sāgaraiḥ bhūtim avāptaḥ sumahān vadhaḥ
verses.translation: "Previously, the sons of Sagara belonging to our race, were got bitterly digging up the earth, as commanded by their father."

verses.devanagari:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण रेणुका जननी स्वयम् |
कृत्ता परशुना अरण्ये पितुर् वचन कारिणा
verses.iast:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa reṇukā jananī svayam |
kṛttā paraśunā araṇye pitur vacana kāriṇā
verses.translation: "Parasu Rama, the son of Jamadagni personally slayed his mother Renuka in the forest with an axe as per his father's words."

verses.devanagari:
एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम् |
पितुर्वचनमक्लीबम् करिष्यामि पितुर्शितम्
verses.iast:
etairanyaiśca bahubhirdevi devasamaiḥ kṛtam |
piturvacanamaklībam kariśhyāmi piturśitam
verses.translation: "Oh, mother! These and many others who were equivalent to gods, did not make their father' s words to go waste. I shall also do what is desired by my father"

glosses.meaning: words kR^itam = was made akliibam = no waste

verses.devanagari:
न खल्व् एतन् मया एकेन क्रियते पितृ शासनम् |
एतैरपि कृतम् देवि ये मया तव कीर्तिताः
verses.iast:
na khalv etan mayā ekena kriyate pitṛ śāsanam |
etairapi kṛtam devi ye mayā tava kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, mother! I am not the only person to act according to father's command. Those I have mentioned to you hitherto also complied with their father's command."

glosses.meaning: was not done mayaa = by me

verses.devanagari:
नाहम् धर्ममपूर्वम् ते प्रतिकूलम् प्रवर्तये |
पूर्वैः अयम् अभिप्रेतः गतः मार्गो अनुगम्यते
verses.iast:
nāham dharmamapūrvam te pratikūlam pravartaye |
pūrvaiḥ ayam abhipretaḥ gataḥ mārgo anugamyate
verses.translation: "I am not setting any new contradicting customary conduct for your sake. I am adhering to the way agreed and followed by the ancient."

verses.devanagari:
तत् एतत् तु मया कार्यम् क्रियते भुवि न अन्यथा |
पितुर् हि वचनम् कुर्वन् न कश्चिन् नाम हीयते
verses.iast:
tat etat tu mayā kāryam kriyate bhuvi na anyathā |
pitur hi vacanam kurvan na kaścin nāma hīyate
verses.translation: "I cannot do otherwise than acting in accordance with father's words, the prevalent practice on earth. There is no deprivation indeed for anyone who complies with father's commands."

verses.devanagari:
ताम् एवम् उक्त्वा जननीम् लक्ष्मणम् पुनर् अब्रवीत् |
तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tām evam uktvā jananīm lakṣmaṇam punar abravīt |
tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi sneham anuttamam
verses.translation: Rama, the best of those who speak skilfully and the best of all those wearing the bow, spoke thus to his mother and turned round to Lakshmana to speak.

glosses.meaning: of all those wearing the bow

verses.devanagari:
तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहमनुत्तमम् |
विक्रमम् चैव सत्यम् च तेजश्च सुदुरासदम्
verses.iast:
tava lakśmaṇa jānāmi mayi snehamanuttamam |
vikramam caiva satyam ca tejaśca sudurāsadam
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana ! I know your highest affection towards me, your heroic valour ,your strength and your unassailable splendour ."

glosses.meaning: I know tava = your anuttamam = highest sneham = affection mayi = in me vikramam chaiva = heroic valour sattvam cha = strength

verses.devanagari:
मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलम् शुभलक्षम्ण |
अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च
verses.iast:
mama māturmahadduḥkhamatulam śubhalakśamṇa |
abhiprāyam aviGYāya satyasya ca śamasya ca
verses.translation: " Oh, Lakshmana, with good attributes! My mother is feeling a great and unequalled sorrow, by not knowing the secret of truth and tranquillity."

glosses.itrans: with good attributes! atulam mahat duHkham
glosses.iast: vith good attributes! atulam mahat duḥkham
glosses.devanagari: विथ् गोओद् अत्त्रिबुतेस्! अतुलं महत् दुःखं
glosses.meaning: there is an unqualled and great grief

verses.devanagari:
धर्मः हि परमः लोके धर्मे सत्यम् प्रतिष्ठितम् |
धर्म संश्रितम् एतच् च पितुर् वचनम् उत्तमम्
verses.iast:
dharmaḥ hi paramaḥ loke dharme satyam pratiṣṭhitam |
dharma saṃśritam etac ca pitur vacanam uttamam
verses.translation: "Righteousness is the best of all qualities in the world. Truth is established in righteousness. Even these best words of father are enjoined with righteousness."

verses.devanagari:
संश्रुत्य च पितुर् वाक्यम् मातुर् वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा |
न कर्तव्यम् वृथा वीर धर्मम् आश्रित्य तिष्ठता
verses.iast:
saṃśrutya ca pitur vākyam mātur vā brāhmaṇasya vā |
na kartavyam vṛthā vīra dharmam āśritya tiṣṭhatā
verses.translation: "One who follows righteousness, does not waste his promise given to one's father or mother or Brahmana."

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् न शक्ष्यामि पितुर् नियोगम् अतिवर्तितुम् |
पितुर् हि वचनात् वीर कैकेय्या अहम् प्रचोदितः
verses.iast:
so aham na śakṣyāmi pitur niyogam ativartitum |
pitur hi vacanāt vīra kaikeyyā aham pracoditaḥ
verses.translation: " I cannot transgress my father's command. On the word given by my father only, Kaikeyi instigated me to go to the forest."

verses.devanagari:
तत् एनाम् विसृज अनार्याम् क्षत्र धर्म आश्रिताम् मतिम् |
धर्मम् आश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यम् मद् बुद्धिर् अनुगम्यताम्
verses.iast:
tat enām visṛja anāryām kṣatra dharma āśritām matim |
dharmam āśraya mā taikṣṇyam mad buddhir anugamyatām
verses.translation: "Hence, leave this mean mentality of military heroism. Observe righteousness and not rudeness. follow my perception."

verses.devanagari:
तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सौहार्दात् भ्रातरम् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः |
उवाच भूयः कौसल्याम् प्रान्जलिः शिरसा आनतः
verses.iast:
tam evam uktvā sauhārdāt bhrātaram lakṣmaṇa agrajaḥ |
uvāca bhūyaḥ kausalyām prānjaliḥ śirasā ānataḥ
verses.translation: Rama spoke thus to his brother affectionately, bowed to his mother and with folded hands, spoke again to Kausalya as follows.

verses.devanagari:
अनुमन्यस्व माम् देवि गमिष्यन्तम् इतः वनम् |
शापिता असि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे
verses.iast:
anumanyasva mām devi gamiṣyantam itaḥ vanam |
śāpitā asi mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me
verses.translation: "OH, mother! I have decided to go to forest. Please give me permission. I am swearing to you on my life. Please invoke blessings on me."

verses.devanagari:
तीर्ण प्रतिज्ञः च वनात् पुनर् एष्याम्य् अहम् पुरीम् |
ययातिरिव राजर्षिः पुरा हित्वा पुनर्धिवम्
verses.iast:
tīrṇa pratiGYaḥ ca vanāt punar eṣyāmy aham purīm |
yayātiriva rājarśhiḥ purā hitvā punardhivam
verses.translation: "As sage king named Yayati in olden times left the heaven and reached back heaven again, I shall be back to the city from the forest, after fulfilling my promise."

verses.devanagari:
शोकस्संधार्यताम् मातर्हृदये साधु मा शुचः |
वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः
verses.iast:
śokassaṃdhāryatām mātarhṛdaye sādhu mā śucaḥ |
vanavāsādihaiśhyāmi punaḥ kṛtvā piturvacaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, mother! Please do not grieve, Bear it well in your heart. I shall come back here again from the forest after fulfilling the father's command."

verses.devanagari:
त्वया मया च वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन सुमित्रया |
पितुर्नियोगे स्थातव्यमेष धर्मः सनाअनः
verses.iast:
tvayā mayā ca vaidehyā lakśmaṇena sumitrayā |
piturniyoge sthātavyameśha dharmaḥ sanāanaḥ
verses.translation: "You and I, Sita, Lakshmana, Sumintra and all of us should follow father's directions. This is an eternal custom."

verses.devanagari:
अम्ब सम्हृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखम् हृदि निगृह्य च |
वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धर्म्यानुवर्त्यताम्
verses.iast:
amba samhṛtya sambhārān duḥkham hṛdi nigṛhya ca |
vanavāsakṛtā buddhirmama dharmyānuvartyatām
verses.translation: "Oh mother! Please approve my righteous intention of going to the forest, duly withdrawing preparations for my coronation and keeping in check the sorrow in your heart."

verses.devanagari:
एतद्वच स्तस्य निशम्य माता |
सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लबम् च |
मृतेव सम्ज्ञाम् प्रतिलभ्य देवी |
समीक्ष्य रामम् पुनरित्युवाच
verses.iast:
etadvaca stasya niśamya mātā |
sudharmyamavyagramaviklabam ca |
mṛteva samjJṇām pratilabhya devī |
samīkśya rāmam punarityuvāca
verses.translation: The mother Kausalya heard the most virtuous, cool and steady words of Rama and rose, as though regained consciousness once more after death, looked at Rama and spoke thus again.

verses.devanagari:
यथैव ते पुत्र पिता तथाहम् |
गुरुः स्वधर्मेण सुहृत्तया च |
न त्वानुजानामि न मांविहाय |
सुदुःखितामर्हसि गन्तुमेवम्
verses.iast:
yathaiva te putra pitā tathāham |
guruḥ svadharmeṇa suhṛttayā ca |
na tvānujānāmi na māṃvihāya |
suduḥkhitāmarhasi gantumevam
verses.translation: "Oh, son! I am also as respectable a person to you as your father, in my own right and due to great affection. I do not give permission to you. You cannot thus go away, leaving me in great sorrow."

verses.devanagari:
किम् जीवितेनेह विना त्वया मे |
लोकेन वा किम् स्वधयाऽमृतेन |
श्रेयो मुहूर्तम् तव सन्निधानम् |
ममेह कृत्स्नादपि जीवलोकात्
verses.iast:
kim jīviteneha vinā tvayā me |
lokena vā kim svadhayā'mṛtena |
śreyo muhūrtam tava sannidhānam |
mameha kṛtsnādapi jīvalokāt
verses.translation: "What is the use of my living in this world without you? What is the use of the other world or the oblation of food offered to the deceased ancestors or the nectar of immortality? Your proximity even for a moment is better than that of the entire world of living beings."

glosses.meaning: without you? kim = what is the use
or the oblation of food offered to the deceased ancestors
or the nectar of immortality? tava = your

verses.devanagari:
नरैरिवोल्काभिरपोह्यमानो |
महागजोऽध्वानमनुप्रविष्टः |
भूयः प्रजज्वाल विलापमेवम् |
निशम्य रामः करुणम् जनन्या
verses.iast:
narairivolkābhirapohyamāno |
mahāgajo'dhvānamanupraviśhṭaḥ |
bhūyaḥ prajajvāla vilāpamevam |
niśamya rāmaḥ karuṇam jananyā
verses.translation: After hearing the pathetic lamentation of his mother, he was highly anguished, as when an elephant is removed highly from its way by men with flames of fire.

verses.devanagari:
स मातरम् चैव विसम्ज्ञकल्पा |
मार्तम् च सौमित्रि मभिप्रतप्तम् |
धर्मे स्थितो धर्म्यमुवाच वाक्यम् |
यथा स एवार्हति तत्र वक्तुम्
verses.iast:
sa mātaram caiva visamjJṇakalpā |
mārtam ca saumitri mabhiprataptam |
dharme sthito dharmyamuvāca vākyam |
yathā sa evārhati tatra vaktum
verses.translation: Rama, who was established in righteousness, spoke these words endowed with virtue, to his mother who was looking unconscious and to Lakshmana who was disturbed and exhausted with distress. He was the only person worthy of speaking thus at that time.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् हि ते लक्ष्मण नित्यमेव |
जानामि भक्तिम् च पराक्रमम् च |
मम त्वभिप्राय मसन्निरीक्ष्य |
मात्रा सहाभ्यर्दसि मा सुदुःखम्
verses.iast:
aham hi te lakśmaṇa nityameva |
jānāmi bhaktim ca parākramam ca |
mama tvabhiprāya masannirīkśya |
mātrā sahābhyardasi mā suduḥkham
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! I always know your devotion towards me as well as your strength. But now, you are joining with mother in afflicting much trouble to me without looking at my opinion."

verses.devanagari:
धर्मार्थकामाः खलु तात लोके |
समीक्षिता धर्मफलोदयेषु |
ते तत्र सर्वे स्युरसंशयम् मे |
भार्येव वश्याभिमता सुपुत्रा
verses.iast:
dharmārthakāmāḥ khalu tāta loke |
samīkśitā dharmaphalodayeśhu |
te tatra sarve syurasaṃśayam me |
bhāryeva vaśyābhimatā suputrā
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! In obtaining the fruit of good works in the world, righteousness utility and free will are being considered. As a wife who is obedient, who is beloved and who is having good sons, good work yields all these three things."

glosses.meaning: in obtaining the fruit of good works

verses.devanagari:
यस्मिंस्तु सर्वे स्युरसन्निविष्टा |
धर्मो यतः स्यात् तदुपक्रमेत |
द्वेष्यो भवत्यर्थपरो हि लोके |
कामात्मता खल्वपि न प्रशस्ता
verses.iast:
yasmiṃstu sarve syurasanniviśhṭā |
dharmo yataḥ syāt tadupakrameta |
dveśhyo bhavatyarthaparo hi loke |
kāmātmatā khalvapi na praśastā
verses.translation: "Only such an action, which is righteous, is to be initiated, leaving that in which wealth, desire and righteousness do not come together. One who is intested in wealth alone becomes indeed fit to be hated in the world. So also the one whose very essence is desire, cannot indeed be considered good.

glosses.meaning: one who is intested in wealth alone

verses.devanagari:
गुरुश्च राजा च पिता च वृद्धः |
क्रोधात्प्रहर्ष द्यदि वापि कामात् |
यद्व्यादिशेत् कार्यमवेक्ष्य धर्मम् |
कस्तन्न कुर्यादनृदनृशंसवृत्तिः
verses.iast:
guruśca rājā ca pitā ca vṛddhaḥ |
krodhātpraharśha dyadi vāpi kāmāt |
yadvyādiśet kāryamavekśya dharmam |
kastanna kuryādanṛdanṛśaṃsavṛttiḥ
verses.translation: "When father, who is venerable, a king and old-aged, commands an action either by anger or by extreme joy or by even desire, which right person will not perform it? Only a person who chooses to be cruel will not do it."

verses.devanagari:
सवै न शक्नोमि पितुः प्रतिज्ञा |
मिमामकर्तुम् सकलम् यथावत् |
स ह्यवयोस्तत गुरुर्नियोगे |
देवाश्च भर्ता स गतिस्स धर्मः
verses.iast:
savai na śaknomi pituḥ pratijJṇā |
mimāmakartum sakalam yathāvat |
sa hyavayostata gururniyoge |
devāśca bhartā sa gatissa dharmaḥ
verses.translation: "I cannot avoid fulfilling the father's command completely. For both of us, he is an important person indeed to command us. To mother Kausalya also, he is the husband, the resource person and the personified law."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् पुनर्जीवति धर्मराजे |
विशेषतः स्वे पथि वर्तमाने |
देवी मया सार्थमितोऽपगच्छेत् |
कथम् स्विदन्या विधवेव नारी
verses.iast:
tasmin punarjīvati dharmarāje |
viśeśhataḥ sve pathi vartamāne |
devī mayā sārthamito'pagacchet |
katham svidanyā vidhaveva nārī
verses.translation: "while the righteous king Dasaratha is alive and especially when he is following his own righteous path, how the mother Kausalya can go out with me from here leaving the city like other widowed woman?"

verses.devanagari:
सा मानुमन्यस्व वनम् व्रजन्तम् |
कुरुष्व नः स्वस्त्ययनानि देवि |
यथा समाप्ते पुनराव्रजेयम् |
यथा हि स्त्येन पुनर्ययातिः
verses.iast:
sā mānumanyasva vanam vrajantam |
kuruśhva naḥ svastyayanāni devi |
yathā samāpte punarāvrajeyam |
yathā hi styena punaryayātiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, mother the queen! Permit me to go to forest. As Yayati returned to heaven by the power of truth, give me your power of blessings so that I can return here after completion of exile."

verses.devanagari:
यशो ह्यहम् केवलराज्यकारणात् |
न पृष्ठतः कर्तुमलम् महोदयम् |
अदीर्घकाले न तु देवि जीविते |
वृणेऽवरामद्य महीमधर्मतः
verses.iast:
yaśo hyaham kevalarājyakāraṇāt |
na pṛśhṭhataḥ kartumalam mahodayam |
adīrghakāle na tu devi jīvite |
vṛṇe'varāmadya mahīmadharmataḥ
verses.translation: "I cannot keep back reputation and glory for the sake of kingdom alone. This cannot unrighteously long for this inferior kingdom."

glosses.meaning: for the sake of kingdom alone

verses.devanagari:
प्रसादयन् नर वृषभः स मातरम् |
पराक्रमाज्जिगमिषुरेव दोम्डकान् |
अथ अनुजम् भ्ऱ्शम् अनुशास्य दर्शनम् |
चकार ताम् ह्ऱ्दि जननीम् प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.iast:
prasādayan nara vṛṣabhaḥ sa mātaram |
parākramājjigamiśhureva domḍakān |
atha anujam bhRśam anuśāsya darśanam |
cakāra tām hRdi jananīm pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Rama, the best of men, decided to go to Dandaka forest fearlessly with his prowess, consoled his mother, advised his brother by good thoughts and made hearty circumbulatory salutation to his mother.
